start_cook.name: Start cook
start_cook.description: Start cooking at a target temperature with an optional timer.

timer.name: Timer
timer.description: Cook timer in seconds. 0 means no timer.

stop_cook.name: Stop cook
stop_cook.description: Stop cooking and turn off the cooker.

set_timer.name: Set timer
set_timer.description: Set the cook timer in seconds while keeping the cooker running at the current target temperature.

reset_timer.name: Reset timer
reset_timer.description: Reset the cook timer to zero while keeping the cooker running at the current target temperature.

start_selected_recipe.name: Start selected recipe
start_selected_recipe.description: Trigger the recipe automation currently selected in the recipe selector.

cancel_selected_recipe.name: Cancel selected recipe
cancel_selected_recipe.description: Cancel the recipe automation currently selected in the recipe selector.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Anova. Check your token and internet connection.
error.no_devices: No devices found. Ensure your cooker is connected to Wi-Fi and paired with your account.

user.title: Anova Sous Vide
user.description: Enter your Personal Access Token from the Anova app (More → Developer → Personal Access Tokens).

select_device.title: Select Device
select_device.description: Multiple devices found. Select the cooker to control.
